entries.subject: Celestia native nucleus illustration and catalog scale
entries.finding: Superseded 2026-09-16: the Celestia generic mesh was a shared illustration with no relation to this nucleus, and its catalogue radius was an estimate. The package now shows a smooth ellipsoid at the published effective radius (Bauer et al. (2013), ApJ 773, 22); no mesh from Celestia is retained.
entries.revisitWhen: A measured shape model of this nucleus (radar, spacecraft or a convex lightcurve inversion with a stated pole) would replace the ellipsoid.

entries.subject: Published effective nucleus radius
entries.finding: Bauer et al. (2013), ApJ 773, 22: effective radius 33.1 km ± 11.5. A thermal sphere; no axis ratio is published. Used as the volume-equivalent radius of the displayed ellipsoid.
